name: Craftsman
source:
An instructor of swordsmanship in Zanji Zard, and the one who taught Zena all that she knows about swordfighting.

Loves to drink so much that she sips even during training sessions or while traveling. According to Zena, it is unbelievable how Crafti is able to keep a straight face considering how much she drinks.

Not the type to care about small details, she carries a loose attitude towards most things. Although she gives off the impression of being constantly carefree, Crafti is capable of acting as a dependable big-sister like figure when the situation demands. Is more put -together than she seems, and for better or for worse her loose attitude pulls the party forward in their journey.

[From the [url=https://qureate.co.jp/prisonprincess_ta/en/]official website[/url]]
